description: Use when an agent needs ids that must not collide: cryptographically random UUID v4s, up to 100 in one call, straight from the platform CSPRNG. For idempotency keys, request ids and correlation ids, where a repeat means a duplicate charge or a lost trace. Do not use for a secret or a password (/v1/random/password reports its entropy) or for a hash (/v1/util/sha256). $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

count.description: How many to generate, 1-100. Defaults to 1.
